title: EscudoEvent
description: One step in the presenter timeline. Every component (backend, agents, Android, web) writes events with this shape to Firestore db `escudo`, collection `events`.

run_id.description: Groups one run on the presenter timeline: X-Escudo-Run-Id when sent (scenario runs), else the customer's run (run customers: their run id; the stage customer: her customer id), so asides without a claim stay on the same timeline.

summary.description: One human-readable line in Spanish for the timeline.

data.description: Small, display-safe payload (no PII beyond the fictional seed).
